event.active_recruitment_opportunities_0: You replace the page before the search. {{npc_ari}} stays at the clinic, now without direct evidence against her.
Swap the ledger page
You take the page and open an exit. {{npc_ari}} abandons the false ledger and joins your crew.
Take Ari under your cover
You refuse to erase any more traces. {{npc_ari}} watches you leave with the warrant in her hands.
Tell Ari to answer the warrant
The inspectors return with a warrant carrying {{npc_ari}}’s name this time. The patient under the false file is gone, but the forged page remains in the clinic ledger.
The Warrant on the Ledger
You pay for a second cart and secure the transfer. {{npc_ari}} hands over her shift and joins you.
Hire a private cart
You leave before the lockdown. {{npc_ari}} stays with the three patients until another solution appears.
Leave the ward to Ari
Your route order strands two patients at the wrong gate. You hurt yourself getting them back before closure.
You clear the ward without losing a file or patient. {{npc_ari}} locks the door and joins your crew.
The transfer leaves late. {{npc_ari}} stays behind to finish the handoff.
You move all three patients in time. {{npc_ari}} hands over the files and finally agrees to leave with you.
Organize the transfer
The quarantine ward closes at dawn, but {{npc_ari}} still has three patients too weak to walk. The only medical cart must leave before the port road is sealed.
Transfer Before Dawn
The gate drops on you and the passage leaves. Your friend must choose another route again.
You force open the second gate too. {{npc_childhood_friend}} crosses laughing and joins your crew.
You gain a few seconds, not enough. {{npc_childhood_friend}} remains on the other side of the gate.
You hold the gate long enough. {{npc_childhood_friend}} gets through with his bag and finally joins your crew.
Hold the gate open
You repeat the rule that bound you as children. This time, {{npc_childhood_friend}} does not let the departure pass.
Invoke your old rule
You close the old rule yourself. {{npc_childhood_friend}} keeps his bag and walks back into the night alone.
Part for good
{{npc_childhood_friend}} catches you as the port gates close for the night. The old sign from your childhood is still carved into his bag, but the last passage leaves now.
The Gate of the Second Departure
You lay the old cord between you. This time, {{npc_active_recruit_knot_runner}} agrees to settle the debt beside you.
Call in the old favor
The cord snaps across the quay and hurts you both. The chief seizes the rest of the lot too.
You save the crate and expose the false seizure number. {{npc_active_recruit_knot_runner}} joins you.
The knot gives too late. The crate disappears behind the customs doors.
You free the crate before the final seal. {{npc_active_recruit_knot_runner}} takes back the cord and comes with you.
Cut the crate loose fast
You let the line be cut. {{npc_active_recruit_knot_runner}} salvages what he can without you.
Leave the knot to customs
{{npc_active_recruit_knot_runner}} finds his red cord trapped under a customs seal, tied to a seized crate. The quay chief orders the line cut before the whole shipment is impounded.
The Knot Under Seal
You buy the lot at a steep price and clear the exit. {{npc_active_recruit_lot_runner}} follows after the last chalk mark.
Buy the seized lot
Your appeal turns the crowd against the guards. You take a hit and the auction ends in chaos.
The guards reopen and return the seized lots. {{npc_active_recruit_lot_runner}} closes the auction and joins your route.
The gate stays shut. {{npc_active_recruit_lot_runner}} loses the lot and part of the crowd.
You secure one final clean sale. {{npc_active_recruit_lot_runner}} wipes away the number and chooses to leave with you.
Get the gate reopened
You leave the market to close. {{npc_active_recruit_lot_runner}} stays to calm sellers and buyers.
Walk away from the crowd
Guards close the market while {{npc_active_recruit_lot_runner}} still holds one last chalk number overhead. Sellers crowd the gate and the buyers begin to shove.
The Gate Before the Last Lot
You pay for timber and a mobile shelter. {{npc_active_recruit_notice_carver}} agrees to rebuild the board while traveling with you.
Fund a new board
You do not oppose the agents. {{npc_active_recruit_notice_carver}} stays to carve the lost names from memory.
Let the board burn
You choke on smoke and save the wrong panel. Several names vanish in the fire.
You save the names and the imprint of the forged order. {{npc_active_recruit_notice_carver}} takes her tools and joins you.
You recover fragments, but too many names are already unreadable.
You reconstruct the list before it burns. {{npc_active_recruit_notice_carver}} decides to travel with you to preserve it.
Save the readable names
Agents tear down {{npc_active_recruit_notice_carver}}’s carved board and throw it into a brazier. Beneath the burning paste, several missing-person notices reappear before the flames reach the names.
Names in the Smoke
You leave the drydock. {{npc_owen}} remains alone with the owner and the broken hoist.
Leave Owen with the claim
You pay to end the claim. {{npc_owen}} retrieves his tools and agrees to leave with you.
Pay for the broken keel
Your demonstration breaks a second brace. You are hurt and the yard doubles its claim.
You prove the yard already knew about the crack. {{npc_owen}} takes his tools and joins your crew.
The marks remain ambiguous. The owner keeps the claim against {{npc_owen}}.
You find the old crack in the hoist. The claim collapses and {{npc_owen}} chooses to leave the yard with you.
Prove the hoist failed
A hoist breaks above a keel and the yard blames {{npc_owen}} for bracing the hull badly. The owner demands compensation before anyone can leave the drydock.
The Hoist That Failed
You pull the last wedges. The ramp collapses into the water and {{npc_owen}} disappears through another exit.
Collapse the slipway together
You hand the plans to the patrol. The slipway is seized and {{npc_owen}} immediately understands who exposed it.
Hand over the plans
You abandon the slipway before the soldiers arrive. {{npc_owen}} takes only his tools and joins your crew.
Get Owen out before the sweep
A patrol has found the hidden slipway where {{npc_owen}} repaired unregistered hulls. Boots close in while he pulls the last wedges keeping the ramp from collapsing.
The Hidden Slipway Exposed
You claim the final win. {{npc_childhood_rival}} snaps the notebook shut and joins the other crew.
Add one last point
You strike out the whole column instead of adding a point. {{npc_childhood_rival}} closes the notebook and joins your crew.
Erase the score and invite her
You write down a draw. {{npc_childhood_rival}} smiles, but still chooses her own road.
Settle on a draw
{{npc_childhood_rival}} puts down the notebook where she still counted your wins and debts. Another crew is already waiting at the end of the quay; only one line remains blank.
The Last Line on the Scorecard
The ledger becomes ash before the patrol arrives. {{npc_rohan}} leaves by another street to keep the network alive.
Burn the list and split
You turn the search into a public spectacle. The safehouse holds, but {{npc_rohan}} remains tied to the kitchen.
Keep serving under their eyes
You clear the kitchen before the search. {{npc_rohan}} abandons the ledger and continues the road with you.
Get Rohan out with the pots
A patrol works up the street while {{npc_rohan}} empties the safehouse’s last pot. The meal ledger carries enough marks to connect several couriers to the same network.
The Safehouse’s Last Pot
You leave before service ends. {{npc_rohan}} keeps the kitchen open without your help.
Leave him with the bill
You pay for the missing sacks. After the last bowl, {{npc_rohan}} closes the kitchen and accepts your berth.
Pay the shortfall
The argument turns physical and you take a hit. The supplier leaves with the rice and the debt grows.
You clear the debt by exposing the double ledger. {{npc_rohan}} hangs up his apron and joins your crew.
The supplier refuses the deal. {{npc_rohan}} finishes service with what remains.
You secure one last delivery and a delay. {{npc_rohan}} closes the kitchen and finally agrees to leave with you.
Turn the supplier around
{{npc_rohan}} is still serving when his supplier takes back the rice sacks and demands immediate payment. The dockworkers’ line grows, and the kitchen lacks enough stock to finish service.
The Pot Without a Supplier
You recover the tags and offer him a route instead of another shrine. {{npc_active_recruit_wake_keeper}} joins you.
Carry the tags with him
You search the quay until the tags are found. He thanks you, then returns to his watch.
Recover the tags, then part
You yield to the family. The bell carries far, but {{npc_active_recruit_wake_keeper}} refuses to abandon the other names.
Ring one name
A wave floods {{npc_active_recruit_wake_keeper}}’s quay shrine and sweeps away his brass tags. A family still demands the bell be rung before the next ship departs.
The Tags Taken by the Storm
